MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

3. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

4. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 10
   C. 40.5
   D. 81

5. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

7. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 32
   D. 64

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 30
   C. 40
   D. 75

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 2/3

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 105
   D. 44

13. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 21

14. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 27.6

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 55
   C. 16
   D. 22

18. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

19. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 18
   C. 77
   D. 36

21. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 11

22. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

23. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 16

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
